title: 第674章 天都与万花第673章 天都降临
slug: 全族助我加点我举族飞升天界
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：全族助我加点，我举族飞升天界第二卷：北玄领主第674章天都与万花（..la）待李光宇和紫桃仙子坐下，下方的席位方才继续进行。
只不过没有人去打破这一份平静，所有目光全都落在高台之上那三道无上存在上面。
见到三大主宰同框，这回去之后可以跟其他人吹嘘一辈子了。
这可是何等荣耀的事情！
与下方的情况不同，高台之上。
天都主宰目光落在万花主宰身上，脸上更是带着一抹笑意。
他并未对其说些什么，而是转头看向李北玄像是在开玩笑道，“北玄道友，我族中也是有许多优秀的女子哦，你可不必厚此薄彼了！”
面对天都主宰的玩笑，李北玄笑着回道，“天都道友，小辈自有小辈的缘分，随缘便好！”
“若真有小辈与你族之人看对眼，我倒也是十分乐意！”
这时，万花主宰的声音响起。
“天都主宰，此乃小辈之间的事情，勉强不来的！”
说话间，她面带笑意看着天都主宰。
似乎在跟天都主宰说，就算你的族中女子多又怎样，能有今日这般结果吗？
果然，听到万花主宰之言，天都主宰脸上的笑容也逐渐消失。
他目光看向万花主宰，“万花主宰，你这么说可就不对了！”
“小辈自有小辈的缘分，不过你又怎能确定下一个会轮不到我族？”
他今日前来，便是前来与万花主宰争个高下。
不然他好不容易得来盟友，可就变成对方的了！
东陵小会日益临近，少了这北玄主宰这个盟友，他的计划便会彻底落空。
这便是他今天前来的目的。

李北玄见他们两个对上，连忙出言阻止道，“两位，我人族能够得到你们两族的青睐，乃是我人族之幸。”
“但今日是我人族的大喜之日，来让我等喝一杯！”
说着，他举起玉杯，对着天都主宰，而后又看向万花主宰。
见到李北玄这么说，天都主宰便没再继续出言较劲。
同样举起酒杯对着李北玄笑道，“北玄道友说得在理，今日乃是大喜之日，应当痛饮一番！”
万花主宰也没有意见，玉手端起酒杯，看向李北玄笑道，“北玄道友说的好，今日乃是属于我桃源一族与人族的大喜之日，确实值得祝贺！”
“天都主宰，请！”
说着，她目光转向天都主宰，语气也不由得加重了许多。
像是在示意，也好像是在炫耀他们桃源一族与人族之间的结亲已然是事实。
天都主宰刚刚释然的心，却又开始浮动起来了。
在他听来，自己倒是显得像个外人一样。
但就今日这个场面来看，自己确实就是一个外人！
“万花主宰，北玄主宰，恭喜了！”他有些无奈地朝李北玄两人举杯。
而后率先将杯中美酒一饮而尽。
美酒入肚，但他的心中却不是滋味。
李北玄见两人如此，心中却是有些无奈，并没有说些什么。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: The whole clan helps me add some points, and my whole clan ascends to the heaven. Volume 2: Lord Beixuan Chapter 674 Tiandu and Ten Thousand Flowers (..la) After Li Guangyu and Fairy Zi Tao sat down, the seats below continued.
But no one went to break the peace, and all eyes fell on the three supreme beings on the high platform.
Seeing the three masters in the same frame, I can brag to others for the rest of my life after I go back.
What a glorious thing this is!
Unlike the situation below, above the high platform.
The Lord of Heaven's Capital fell on the Lord of Ten Thousand Flowers, with a smile on his face.
He did not say anything to her, but turned to look at Li Beixuan and said as if he was joking, "Fellow Taoist Beixuan, there are many outstanding women in our clan, so you don't have to favor one over the other!"
Faced with the joke made by the Lord of Tiandu, Li Beixuan smiled and replied, "Fellow Taoist Tiandu, juniors have their own fate, so just let it go!"
"If there is a junior who really looks at each other with someone from your clan, I would be very happy!"
At this time, the voice of the Lord of Ten Thousand Flowers sounded.
"Lord of Heaven, this is a matter between juniors, we can't force it!"
As she spoke, she looked at the Lord of Heaven with a smile.
It seems that he is telling the Lord of Tiandu, so what if there are many women in your clan, can you have the results like today?
Sure enough, after hearing the words of the Lord of Ten Thousand Flowers, the smile on the face of the Lord of Heaven gradually disappeared.
He looked at the Lord of Ten Thousand Flowers and said, "Lord of Ten Thousand Flowers, what you said is wrong!"
"The younger generation has its own destiny, but how can you be sure that it won't be my clan's turn next?"
He came here today just to compete with the Lord of Ten Thousand Flowers.
Otherwise, if he finally gets an ally, he will become the other party's!
The Dongling meeting is getting closer and closer, and without the Beixuan Lord as an ally, his plan will completely fail.
This is the purpose of his coming today.
When Li Beixuan saw the two of them confronting each other, he quickly stopped him and said, "Two of you, it is a blessing for our human race to be favored by both of you."
"But today is a great day for my human race, come and let me have a drink!"
As he spoke, he raised the jade cup and looked at the Lord of Heaven, and then looked at the Lord of Ten Thousand Flowers.
Seeing what Li Beixuan said, the Lord of Tiandu stopped arguing.
He also raised his wine glass and smiled at Li Beixuan, "Fellow Taoist Beixuan is right. Today is a big day, so you should have a good drink!"
The Master of Ten Thousand Flowers had no objection. He held up the wine glass with his jade hand, looked at Li Beixuan and said with a smile, "Fellow Taoist Beixuan said it well. Today is a great day for my Taoyuan clan and the human clan. It is indeed worthy of congratulations!"
"Lord of Heaven, please!"
As she spoke, she turned her gaze to the Lord of Heaven, and her tone became much more serious.
It seemed to be a sign, and it seemed to be showing off that the marriage between the Taoyuan clan and the human race was already a fact.
Lord Tiandu's heart, which had just been relieved, began to wander again.
To him, he sounded like an outsider.
But judging from today's scene, I am indeed an outsider!
"Master of Ten Thousand Flowers, Master of Beixuan, congratulations!" He toasted to Li Beixuan and Li Beixuan helplessly.
Then he drank the wine in one gulp first.
The wine was in his stomach, but it didn't taste good in his heart.
Seeing the two of them like this, Li Beixuan felt helpless and didn't say anything.
